fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { restaurantKitchens: "I run the kitchen at Lumen Bistro. Build a purchase order form my chefs fill on a phone at close: pick the supplier, add lines with item, cases and price per case, and show the running total. When they submit, email the supplier a PDF of the order and save it to a table I can check each morning.", schoolDistricts: "I handle purchasing for Cedar Hills School District. Build one purchase order form for teachers. The budget code dropdown should show only the codes for the teacher's department. If the total is over $1,000, require a vendor quote upload before the form can be submitted, and keep anything without one as a draft.", factoryBuyers: "I buy raw materials for Kessler Fabrication. Build a purchase order form with our vendor list, line items and a ship-to dock. Give each order the next PO number, add the vendor's payment terms, and email the vendor a PDF with a link to confirm the ship date. Show the confirmed date in the orders table.", supplierIntake: "My company is Oakes Packaging, a box supplier for grocery chains. Build a form where business customers send us their purchase orders.
